def transform(grid):
    # The 30x30 canvas contains nine separate 10x10 tiles (3x3 arrangement).
    # Each tile has a particular local pattern; marker colors identify the tile
    # to be copied into the other eight positions. Preserve all pattern cells.
    # Discover the 10x10 motif containing the non-1 special marker and replicate
    # its marker at identical relative coordinates in every tile.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Input tiles are 10x10 but outer boundaries have zeros; tile origins at
    # (0,0),(0,10),(0,20), ...
    special=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c] not in (0,1): special.append((r,c,grid[r][c]))
    # For each distinct marker, copy its location pattern to all corresponding
    # repeated shapes. Here the 1s form motifs replicated with local shape,
    # and the colored cell indicates which repeated motif should be recolored.
    # Tile grid is partitioned by 10-cell blocks; recolor matching local cell
    # in every tile that has a 1 at that coordinate.
    for r,c,color in special:
        br,bc=(r//10)*10,(c//10)*10
        lr,lc=r-br,c-bc
        for tr in range(0,H,10):
            for tc in range(0,W,10):
                if grid[tr+lr][tc+lc]==1:
                    out[tr+lr][tc+lc]=color
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):

    # of its connected-component shape, using translationally repeated motifs.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    markers=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (0,1)]

        # in repeated 10x10 cells: replicate across the corresponding local spot.
